_what: What tool:reboot-a-computer-when-it-asks reads and how long it waits. busy: each test is a shell condition run on the computer; while one is true the computer is not rebooted (id names it, said says it). reboot.after_seconds is how long after the SSH session systemd reboots, first_wait_seconds how long it waits before the first read after that, poll_seconds between reads, wait_seconds how long it waits for the computer to answer with a new boot (a caller may give its own wait_seconds). ssh holds the administrator login (the held key server-administration-ssh-key).

busy.said: a package manager is at work (apt, dpkg or unattended-upgrade)
a container build or a compose run that changes containers is running (a pipeline deploy)
